necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent shortness of breath consistent with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation. To better characterize the frequency and duration of these arrhythmic events and guide long-term management, a 30-day continuous ambulatory ECG monitoring study is indicated. This service corresponds to CPT 93247 and addresses diagnoses I48.91 and I48.0.
